subject: Marketplace listing + PO workflow for Acme Enterprise
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood marketplace listing — PO & vendor setup for Acme Enterprise

Hi Jared / Acme procurement team,

Great to meet you on the call earlier. To get Acme onto the AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace in time for your Q4 rollout we need to confirm a few procurement items so our finance and partner ops teams can create the listing and enable billing: 

- Preferred marketplace path (AWS Marketplace SaaS, Azure Marketplace, or GCP Marketplace)
- Billing entity name, remit address, and PO email for invoicing
- Whether you plan to use marketplace metered billing or a direct PO (upfront monthly commit)
- DUNS / tax ID and any vendor onboarding forms you require us to complete

I attached our Vendor Activation Checklist to speed the intake. If you already have a template PO (or a preferred contract/terms-of-sale), please send that over and we’ll route to finance.

Next steps: if procurement can confirm the marketplace choice and attach your PO template, I’ll loop in our partner ops (CloudBridge) for listing activation and provide the DocuSign for the listing agreement. Targeting a two-week activation once PO and W9 are received.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Activation-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing — PO & vendor setup for Acme Enterprise

Marcus — copying Van on the marketplace ops details. For AWS Marketplace SaaS the activation flow is:

1) We need Acme to sign the Marketplace Listing Agreement (DocuSign) and return PO/W9 to finance@redwood.com.
2) CloudBridge (our marketplace partner) needs the signed agreement + Seller ID to create the listing in their portal.
3) Once the listing is created CloudBridge will enable meter reporting and link billing to Acme's AWS account (deferred billing) — that process usually takes 1–2 weeks after contract + PO.

I’m attaching the internal AWS listing guidance we use; it lists the required fields for the DocuSign and where to upload vendor paperwork. For the security questionnaire, send it to security-eval@redwood.com and we’ll route to security/engineering.

Action items for Marcus:
- Send signed DocuSign link to Jared once DocuSign is live
- Ask Acme to upload W9 to the secure Drive folder below (or email to finance if they prefer)
- Provide preferred marketplace choice explicitly (AWS confirms above)

Lauren Bishop
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: AWS-Marketplace-Listing-Guide.pdf (application/pdf)

From: CloudBridge Onboarding <onboarding@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace_ops@cloudbridge.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood marketplace listing — PO & vendor setup for Acme Enterprise

Thanks for the heads-up. To speed activation for Acme:

- Please send the signed Marketplace Listing Agreement (DocuSign) and seller details to marketplace_ops@cloudbridge.com.
- Required payload: Seller legal name, Seller SellerID (we will generate if missing), product SKU, and the PO reference number.
- For deferred billing we need to confirm the AWS account that will be used for metered billing and an email for billing notifications.

We’ve attached a short activation checklist specific to CloudBridge to show typical timing and upload locations. Once we receive the docs we’ll queue the listing (turnaround ~5 business days).

Onboarding Team
CloudBridge Marketplace Ops
onboarding@cloudbridge.com
marketplace_ops@cloudbridge.com

Attachment: CloudBridge-activation-steps.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jared Park <jared.park@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, marketplace_ops@cloudbridge.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing — PO & vendor setup for Acme Enterprise

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Acme confirms AWS Marketplace SaaS (confirmed by Jared) — will proceed with deferred (metered) billing.
2) Marcus/Redwood: I will kick off DocuSign for the Marketplace Listing Agreement today and send the link to Jared.
3) Jared/Acme: please return signed DocuSign + W9. You can upload W9 to the secure Drive folder below or email to finance@redwood.com. Also include the PO reference number when returning the DocuSign.
4) CloudBridge: once you receive signed DocuSign + seller payload, please create the SellerID and queue the listing. Notify Vanessa when listing is live so we can enable meter reporting.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-Acme-Onboarding
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-117
DocuSign (will be sent today): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcd-1234-aws-listing

Target timeline: receive PO/W9 by 20 Aug -> listing queued by CloudBridge week of 24 Aug -> live by 28 Aug (contingent on seller payload). If procurement needs an invoice in advance (direct PO) instead of deferred billing, we can switch to that path but need notice today to route through finance with a payment term.

Let me know if anyone needs me to open a billing case with finance or attach additional paperwork.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
